Class LevelUpBonus

java.lang.Object
models.game.LevelUpBonus
public class LevelUpBonus extends Object
Represents a bonus option proposed to the player when a Bugemon levels up.

Each bonus is composed of stat modifications (HP, attack, defense, initiative) with a total of 10 points. Conversion: 1 point = 2 HP or 2 Initiative or 1 Attack or 1 Defense.

Examples of pure bonuses: - +20 HP (10 points * 2 HP/point) - +10 Attack (10 points * 1 Atk/point) - +10 Defense (10 points * 1 Def/point) - +20 Initiative (10 points * 2 Init/point)
